headword: {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}

definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that is carefully and completely prepared, with no detail overlooked. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) expressing thoroughness in preparation.

examples.japanese: {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{用意周到|よういしゅうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: She proceeded with her preparations meticulously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{用意周到|よういしゅうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{隠滅|いんめつ}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The culprit had meticulously destroyed the evidence.

notes:
A yojijukugo (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining ⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧ (preparation) and ⟦{周到|しゅうとう}→周到：09063_shuutou⟧ (thorough, careful). It is always positive in describing the quality of preparation, though it can be used for both good and bad actors (e.g., a criminal who planned carefully).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a well-prepared person
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}な⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧: a meticulously planned operation
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act with thorough preparation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{周到|しゅうとう}→周到：09063_shuutou⟧: thorough, careful — the second half of this compound, usable on its own
- ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧: perfect, flawless — emphasizes completeness of preparation
- ⟦{念入|ねんい}り→念入り：14892_neniri⟧: careful, thorough — emphasizes taking extra care with details
